title: Single impurity-induced localization transitions in electronic systems
summary: Anderson localization is a fundamental phenomenon in disordered quantum systems, where transport is suppressed by wave interference from extensive randomness. Moving beyond traditional multi-impurity scenarios, we investigate impurity-induced localization phenomena in low-dimensional tight-binding systems by focusing on the properties of impurity-generated bound states.
